question: The graphs of two linear equations, x + 2y = 15 and 4x + 8y = 13 will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare the coefficients of the variables **x** and **y** in the given equations.

Ratio of x-coefficients (a₁/a₂) = 1/4

Ratio of y-coefficients (b₁/b₂) = 2/8 = 1/4

Ratio of constants (c₁/c₂) = 15/13

Since 1/4 = 1/4 ≠ 15/13, the lines are **parallel**.

**∴ The correct answer is parallel.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation 1: **x + 2y = 15** (where a₁ = 1, b₁ = 2, c₁ = 15)

Equation 2: **4x + 8y = 13** (where a₂ = 4, b₂ = 8, c₂ = 13)

**Condition for Parallel Lines:**

For two linear equations a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂, the lines are **parallel** if:

(a₁/a₂) = (b₁/b₂) ≠ (c₁/c₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f05131ce6e8f55241315b02c2282112776cb6a09c28bba4f8d5268768c149f70.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ a₁/a₂ = 1/4

⇒ b₁/b₂ = 2/8 = 1/4

⇒ c₁/c₂ = 15/13

⇒ 1/4 = 1/4 ≠ 15/13

⇒ Therefore, the system of equations has **no solution** and the graphs are **parallel lines**.

**∴ The correct answer is parallel.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Intersecting Lines

If (a₁/a₂) ≠ (b₁/b₂), the lines intersect at exactly **one point** (Unique solution).

Coincident Lines

If (a₁/a₂) = (b₁/b₂) = (c₁/c₂), the lines overlap and are **coincident** (Infinitely many solutions).

Consistency

A system is **Inconsistent** if the lines are parallel (no solution) and **Consistent** if there is at least one solution.</p
